reviews.text: …a great variety of classes to suit everyone…
Awesome gym and amazing spa area.
…I joined the boxercise class 3x a week with Rey who is brilliant.
full: I joined this gym for 4 weeks during my stay. Loved it! The kit is great for weightlifting. They have classes and I joined the boxercise class 3x a week with Rey who is brilliant. All the staff are so friendly and Tio on the front desk has been a star. Great protein shakes too. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: …Ray delivered the lesson at a very high level with terrific dedication.
full: I really enjoyed the boxing class ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

In one class I learned about several patterns that I should have corrected years ago. That's a lot of progress and a tremendous credit to the coach 👍 Ray sees the student very well and is very clear about the points that need to be corrected.

Ray delivered the lesson at a very high level with terrific dedication. He enjoys teaching and imparts his knowledge with passion. It's a very comfy class environment and I was impressed for a long time after the class. I've been going to a gym for over 20 years as a customer and over 10 years as a trainer, have studied and worked in a lot of holding companies, so I can say very clearly that a trainer who combines all the necessary qualities is very rare. Bravo! My wife also has over 15 years of teaching experience and she also commented on how great the class was because of trainer great work. This is very rare, very very rare, so I decided to share what I see. Really appreciate professional work of the highest caliber in any field. Thank you for the class! That is why this place is called Elit Fit 🏆

reviews.text: …the energy of the coaches - Icha, Rey, Tinos - that just really makes you want to work harder!
full: I would give this gym 10 stars if that was possible! I did try a few of the gym's around Canggu before committing to Elite fit and it was the best addition to my life in Bali.

I love that the weight training area is so extensive with so much space for everyone. I don't think I ever wasted any time having to wait for a machine because someone else was using it. I also really enjoyed the workout classes. What really made it so fun was the energy of the coaches - Icha, Rey, Tinos - that just really makes you want to work harder!

My goal for Bali was focusing on my fitness journey. During my first week I took a Mobility class with Martijn and he was the FIRST trainer EVER to notice that I'm hypermobile. So I instantly signed up for 10 PT sessions with him and it was the best money I spent. I asked him a million questions and he was basically my fitness encyclopedia. He also has the best hacks for upper body days - my back day has forever been changed for the better! My body scan also showed that I increased my skeletal muscle mass from 22.3 to 23 and genuinely by the time I left, I felt so much more stronger and like I wasn't training blindly anymore. I'm so grateful for everything I learned from him!

The recovery area - I basically lived there! It's so aesthetically pleasing, I never felt like it's overcrowded and depending on the time of day you may even have it all to yourself which is the most conducive for relaxing and recovery. I loved that the cafe right upstairs has a nice view so you can do your workout, go for recovery and then move upstairs to grab a bite to eat while you work on your laptop.

And finally, THE STAFF - I can't say it enough but they were the highlight for me. Being a digital nomad and living abroad can be isolating sometimes and the gym being a constant in my routine, it's the staff that I saw EVERY DAY and they really went above and beyond from just being hospitable and polite. I genuinely felt so cared for by every single person there. From Gede & Made smiling ear to ear when they greet me (even if it's 7am it's the best way to start the day seeing such happy people), to the babes at the front desk (Yuni, Dea, Tio, Tata, Asri, Diana, Mei) who greet me when I enter and genuinely converse with me about how I'm doing. They're always so bubbly and happy and it never feels forced or obligatory chit chat. Then there's the amazing guys at the cafe (Timmy, Gunter, Ferry, Tama, Komang + all the kitchen staff) that fed me SO WELL those two months, from making my preworkouts & remembering my protein shake order and making the best steak and veggies which became my usual. I genuinely was so sad when Gunther made my last protein shake haha Then there's the lovely people at the recovery area and cafe (Ratih, Putu, Willy, Nova, Widya, Artha, Rey) they were always so kind, so polite, so conversational in the best ways! There's so many more people I'm sure I haven't mentioned but overall everyone was so funny, so friendly, so genuine and it really made me feel at home.

I know first hand that the work culture is not set from the bottom up but from the top down so I truly give so much credit to Putu for the environment he's created at his gym for the members and for his staff. I went up to him the first week itself and was like "I love your gym" and I didn't even know at the time how much more I would come to love it over time.

To sum up - the gym alone with the equipment/space already makes the place top tier and great for your workout. The recovery area is high quality. The food is great + very reasonably priced. But the PEOPLE that work there just change the whole game because they don't treat you like you're just another member & it's their job to be nice to you but they treat you like you're an actual person and try to get to know you over time. That's such a personal experience that is just unmatched compared to the other places. I can't wait to go back next year!
Anyway, thank you for coming to my ted talk...
